excursions.title: Shipwreck & Nurse Shark Snorkeling
excursions.description: Dive into the keyhole shipwreck of Vaavu Atoll, swim alongside gentle nurse sharks, and walk on a pristine sandbank.
excursions.highlights: Vaavu Keyhole Shipwreck, Nurse Shark swimming, buffet lunch on sandbank, dolphin watching

excursions.title: Manta Ray Snorkeling Safari
excursions.description: An unforgettable encounter with the majestic manta rays of the Maldives. Snorkel in current channels where mantas feed.
excursions.highlights: Snorkeling with Manta Rays, vibrant coral reef drift, underwater photography tips

excursions.title: Sunset Dolphin Cruise
excursions.description: Sail out as the sun sets over the Indian Ocean to watch wild spinner dolphins jumping and playing in the waves.
excursions.highlights: Spinner dolphins spotting, golden hour photo ops, complimentary sunset drinks on deck

private_bookings.title: Private Speedboat Charter
private_bookings.description: Rent our premium speedboat with a dedicated captain and guide. Customize your own itinerary to sandbanks, reefs, or local islands.
private_bookings.highlights: 100% customizable itinerary, private captain & crew, snorkeling gear & towels included

private_bookings.title: Private Sandbank Proposal Package
private_bookings.description: Surprise your partner with a private sandbank excursion. Features a setup with cushions, carpets, fruit platter, and a sunset dinner.
private_bookings.highlights: Exclusive sandbank access, romantic table setup, professional photography, gourmet dinner

freediving.title: AIDA 1 & 2 Freediver Course
freediving.description: Learn the fundamentals of breath-holding, equalization, breathing techniques, and safety procedures down to 20 meters.
freediving.highlights: AIDA certification, breathing & relaxation workshops, open water diving, safety training

freediving.title: Guided Line Training & Depth Sessions
freediving.description: For certified freedivers looking to practice depth, technique, and buddy safety under the direct supervision of an instructor.
freediving.highlights: Constant weight coaching, safety diver support, dive computer analysis, deep buoy setups

resorts.title: Adaaran Prestige Vadoo Pass
resorts.description: Spend a luxury day on a 5-star overwater villa resort. Day pass includes buffet lunch, unlimited premium beverages, and access to pool/beach.
resorts.highlights: All-inclusive buffet & drinks, access to overwater resort pools, pristine reef snorkeling

resorts.title: Centara Ras Fushi Resort Pass
resorts.description: Experience the adults-only playground of Centara Ras Fushi. Pass includes lunch, open bar, and non-motorized water sports.
resorts.highlights: Adults-only beach club, open bar with tropical cocktails, catamaran and paddleboard usage

testimonials.name: Sarah Jenkins
testimonials.text: The shipwreck tour was the absolute highlight of our honeymoon! Swimming with dozens of nurse sharks felt surreal. Highly recommend!

testimonials.name: Liam Peterson
testimonials.text: Exceptional service. Captain Ibrahim navigated through beautiful channels and spots where we saw manta rays and dolphins. 10/10.

testimonials.name: Monica & David
testimonials.text: We booked the Private Proposal sandbank trip. Everything was set up so beautifully with lanterns, rugs, and a delicious barbecue dinner.
